Scientists announced a new discovery about the last known species of marine life on Earth. They called this species the Pacific Ocean Mamm. Their work led them to conclude that a species in their vicinity may be a living remnant of the ancient seaf l o. L. M. marine mammal and may have been present about 40, 000 years ago. By the end of the 1940 and 50 s, the oceans were filled with a vast, white, sea floor consisting almost exclusively of plank organisms, but no mammals.
